deviations.description: test-four-tier-conflict.sh case 1's fixture (fixed-sleep backgrounded releaser) races under extreme CPU contention, discovered during this phase's own load-testing of the case 5/6 fix
deviations.reason: Case 1 was correctly confirmed clean by Phase 2's own narrower read (its assertion condition never compares elapsed time); the newly discovered race is in the fixture's construction, one level removed, and only manifests at load levels (15-20 1-min avg) well beyond what reproduces case 6 (~12.55). Fixing it would widen Phase 2's already-landed, verified-correct scope under time pressure; spawned a dedicated follow-up task instead, with the full reproduction method recorded for a future dispatch to verify against.
